Unmodified copies of three.js r186 examples (MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js), fetched from
https://threejs.org/examples/ on 2026-09-22: webxr_ar_hittest.html, webxr_ar_plane_detection.html,
webxr_ar_lighting.html. scripts/e2e-three-official.mjs serves them under their threejs.org URLs
(HOLOWEB_E2E_LIVE=1 fetches the live pages instead).
